responsibility: Implements the early value range propagation GIMPLE pass itself and its folding drivers. This file defines the evrp_folder and hybrid_folder engines that run substitute-and-fold in dominator order, query ranges from either the classic evrp_range_analyzer or the newer gimple_ranger (with optional pointer equivalence support), compare their results in hybrid modes, set up loop/SCEV/dominator prerequisites, and register the "evrp" gimple_opt_pass entry point that performs early CFG simplification and exports discovered ranges for later consumers such as IPA VRP.
